Why Choose Us

The Elizabethtown Epoxy Flooring Difference

💎

Diamond-Grind Every Job

We use professional diamond grinding equipment on 100% of installs — no acid etching shortcuts. Proper profile = proper adhesion = coating that lasts.

📜

15-Year Written Warranty

Our industry-leading warranty covers peeling, delamination, and flaking for 15 years. You get it in writing before we start — not after.

🏆

Locally Owned & Operated

We live and work in Hardin County. When you call, you talk to the owner — not a call center. Your satisfaction is personal to us.

🎨

25+ Color & Flake Options

From neutral grays to bold metallic blends, we carry over 25 standard color combinations. Custom blends available on request.

🔬

Moisture Testing Before Every Job

We test concrete moisture content before any coating is applied. Wet slabs don't get coated — they get fixed first. No callbacks from moisture failures.

📅

Most Jobs Done in 1–2 Days

Our efficient crew completes most residential garage floors in a single day. You're back to normal life fast, with a beautiful new floor.
